1.consolidated_definition: Sala de estar. Habitación usada como centro de descanso y de reunión familiar. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Además de tener cuatro dormitorios con espacios bien favorables y tres baños y medio, tienen espaciosa sala, comedor, family room, lavandería, terraza y marquesina para dos automóviles (La Estrella de )
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Living room. Room used as a center for rest and family gathering. Raw anglicism, frequent.

In addition to having four bedrooms with favorable spaces and three and a half bathrooms, they have an expansive living room, dining room, family room, laundry area, patio, and carport for two vehicles (The Star).
